results.question: What are the lab rules about pen drives?
results.answer:
The lab rules regarding pen drives are as follows:
1. The use of mobile/any other personal electronic gadgets is prohibited in the laboratory.
2. Do not make noise in the Laboratory & do not sit on experiment table.
3. Do not make loose connections and avoid overlapping wires.
4. Don't switch on power supply without prior permission from the concerned staff.
5. Never point/touch the CRO/Monitor screen with the tip of the open pen/pencil/any other sharp object.
6. Never leave the experiments while in progress.
7. Do not insert/use pen drive/any other storage devices into the CPU.
